text_block_list.text:
After the race, Марузенски appears to
have had a
good time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Even so, she seems somewhat gloomy
heading to
the press conference.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That night, I run into Спешл Уик, who
was
deeply impacted by watching
Марузенски's race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But Марузенски doesn't seem to have
the same
energy that she normally
does...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
